_about: The faction catalogue import (verify/from-bsdata.js adeptus-custodes) reads BSData's whole Adeptus Custodes catalogue through verify/from-json.js as the export catalog-adeptus-custodes; this is its hand file. weaponNames: a weapon BSData names otherwise than GW's datasheet (Wahapedia) by more than the spelling rules of verify/from-json.js can tell, so that GW's profile is found and its values checked; the app keeps BSData's name (New Recruit's, which the in-app import matches), and verify/out/catalog/adeptus-custodes.md lists it as named otherwise. modelNames: a model (stats row) BSData names otherwise than GW's datasheet (its UNIT COMPOSITION, Wahapedia): typo, BSData's spelling is a misprint of GW's name, and the app has GW's (as for every GW misprint or typo, declared in verify/deviations-bsdata.json); kept, another name for the same model (unit and model names follow New Recruit / BSData, as the lists' Vertus Praetors row does), listed in verify/out/catalog/<faction>.md.

Palas Grav-attack.why: BSData's model profile is "Palas Grav-attack"; its datasheet, category and GW's datasheet are "Pallas Grav-attack" (UNIT COMPOSITION: "1 Pallas Grav-attack model"): a misprint, GW's spelling

Gyrfalcon Jetbike.why: BSData names the model after its bike, GW's UNIT COMPOSITION after its rider ("2 Gyrfalcon Jetbiker models"): the same model, another name, not a misprint; BSData's (New Recruit's) name kept, as the lists keep BSData's "Vertus Praetors" for GW's Vertus Praetor models
